skills.name: Inspired Scholarship
skills.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff3443|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

skills.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
skills.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff7524|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff3386|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

skills.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
skills.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff3411|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff10269|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

skills.name: Killer's Blade
skills.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff4274|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff8114|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

skills.name: Resolving Vigor
skills.description:
Let loose a battle cry, instilling yourself with resolve and healing for |cffffff18246|r Health over |cffffff5|r seconds.

After casting you gain Minor Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff2974|r, for |cffffff20|r seconds.

skills.name: The Tide King's Gaze
skills.description:
Tear open the fabric of the Aurbis to unleash a scion of Hermaeus Mora. This being casts forth a beam that rends asunder reality for |cffffff8|r seconds that deals |cffffff4010|r Magic Damage to enemies within 5 meters every |cffffff0.5|r seconds. 

The scion's beam automatically follows the initial target, and hunts for a new one within 8 meters if it is slain.
